name: restaurant_card
description: Venue summary card showing restaurant name, cuisine, star rating, and optional price tier.

name.description: Restaurant name, such as "Kaneo Cliffside Kitchen"

cuisine.description: Cuisine and distance summary, such as "Macedonian Grill · 1.2 km"

rating.description: Star rating from 0 to 5, such as 4.9

events.name: inspect_venue
events.description: Tapping the restaurant card asks for its menu and highlights.

name: availability_gauge
description: Live radial occupancy and wait-time gauge for a restaurant or booking venue.

wait_label.description: Estimated wait time label, such as "12 min wait"

name: seat_selector
description: Interactive floorplan zone and table selector for choosing a specific dining area.

tables.description: Available and occupied tables by zone and seat count

events.name: select_table
events.description: Tapping an available table requests that table zone.
